本书 novel_id=1。请基于 signability-audit 方法论，对全书做**完本级**终检：**逐章通读**所有成稿章节（不得抽样跳章），逐维打分并举证；最终回复末尾**必须**附一个 ```json 代码块，格式：{"verdict":"pass|needs_fix","score":0,"summary":"...","schema_version":2,"issues":[{"id":"I1","level":"P0|P1","area":"维度","desc":"...","fix_type":"body|ledger","target_scope":"active_volume|frozen_volume|none","dimension":"character|locus_arc|timeline|reader_pov|none","direction":"forward_fix|retcon_candidate"}]}——fix_type 必填：body=正文级需章节重写（S5 修不动，将回流 S3 重写回路）；ledger=台账/卷纲/单章 edit 可修。target_scope 必填：active_volume=问题落点在当前活跃卷；frozen_volume=问题落点在已冻结定稿卷（写保护）；none=全书级/不涉具体卷。dimension 必填：character=角色 | locus_arc=地点·弧线 | timeline=时间线 | reader_pov=读者视角（series bible 四维）；不属四维的纯质量问题（节奏/爽点/文笔等）填 none。direction 必填：forward_fix=前向修复（改当前卷及后续适配已定稿前卷，默认）；retcon_candidate=硬矛盾且无法前向消解、需回改已冻结前卷（将进人工审批闸门，慎用）。文风漂移项（如有）走 V 系契约：{"verdict":"pass|needs_fix","score":0,"summary":"...","schema_version":2,"issues":[{"id":"V1","level":"P1","area":"文风漂移·章节#12","desc":"...","fix_type":"body|ledger","target_scope":"active_volume|frozen_volume|none","dimension":"character|locus_arc|timeline|reader_pov|none","direction":"forward_fix|retcon_candidate"}]}（id 从 V1 起编、level 恒 P1、不计入评分与 verdict）；存在任意 P0 致命伤 → verdict=needs_fix；无 P0 且 score≥34/40 → pass。
